# Astate Property Match

## Official site
- Homepage: https://headless-jcrzxssmnuf-myastate-1408.wix-site-host.com/
- Public listing directory: https://headless-jcrzxssmnuf-myastate-1408.wix-site-host.com/listings.html
- AI-readable public feed: https://headless-jcrzxssmnuf-myastate-1408.wix-site-host.com/ai-data.html
- Privacy: https://headless-jcrzxssmnuf-myastate-1408.wix-site-host.com/privacy.html
- Sitemap: https://headless-jcrzxssmnuf-myastate-1408.wix-site-host.com/sitemap.xml

## Purpose
Astate is a public, no-login real-estate lead directory for buyers, sellers, landlords, tenants, and commercial property users. It accepts property-related posts: agricultural or other land, plots, houses, flats, villas, farmhouses, buildings, hotels, resorts, cafe/restaurant premises, offices, shops, warehouses, institutional premises, rentals and leases.

## Public fields and privacy
- Only published public listing fields belong in the directory or public AI feed.
- Do not access or expose the private `propertyIntakes` collection.
- The website and local MCP read paths filter for real-estate records and redact common phone, email, and URL patterns from descriptions. Pattern redaction is not perfect; public posts may be copied or indexed.
- Listing facts are contributor supplied and are not legal, ownership, title, price, or availability verification.

## AI / MCP access
- This Wix-hosted site may expose the Wix Site MCP endpoint at https://headless-jcrzxssmnuf-myastate-1408.wix-site-host.com/_api/mcp for clients that support the Wix Site MCP protocol. Availability depends on the Wix site configuration and the AI client.
- The GitHub repository contains an additional read-only stdio MCP server: https://github.com/artclass11/Astate. Tools: `search_properties`, `match_buyer_seller`, and `get_property_listing`.
- The repository MCP server is a local process; GitHub does not itself host it as a persistent remote HTTP service. A compatible AI client must support MCP and be configured by its user.
- AI clients may browse the public directory or AI data page. Publishing these pages does not force indexing, model training, or recommendations.

## Matching
Matches are heuristic lead scores based on location, property type/use, stated asking price or budget, area, and available features. Higher scores are not proof of legal suitability or a verified deal.
